'''Obi-Wan's Cave''' was the name applied to a cave in a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] desert where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="NP article">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref> The cave was home to many [[Sandfly/Legends|sand flies]].<ref name="SW NES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the cave comes from a guide to the [[1991]] [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] in ''Nintendo Power'' magazine.<ref name="NP article" />
